name: Mrs. Knott's Broiled Atlantic Salmon Fillet with Mashed or Baked Potato (No Lemon Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Tender broiled salmon fillet paired with a plain baked potato (eat the fluffy interior) and chicken noodle soup is a 9.0/10 flare-safe sit-down meal right outside the Knott's main gate.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Broiled Salmon plain (no lemon butter sauce and no lemon wedge) with a plain baked potato or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Ask for no lemon garnish (citrus trigger)
